description: Solo team. I build full stack web tools and I have a background in electronics and Arduino. For this challenge I built Zero Hour Protocol, a health monitor for astronauts on long missions. It tracks vital signs, radiation and cabin air for every crew member, uses real NASA data from OSDR and DONKI, and tells the crew in plain words what is wrong and what to do when Earth is too far away to answer fast. It also works offline and has a voice medic.
